summary: Frontend regression after date-fns 4->3 downgrade, BrowserRouter basename change (PUBLIC_URL), and GitHub Pages SPA redirect (index.html + 404.html). All critical flows verified on preview URL. Home, Destinations, Trips, Offers, Blog, About, Contact all render. Blog uses LOCAL data with ZERO /api/blog requests (confirmed via network interception). 21 articles present (1 featured + 20 cards). Category filtering works. Article detail direct-nav (/blog/first-timers-guide-to-tokyo) renders. Bad slug (/blog/not-a-real-slug-xyz) renders not-found. No render-breaking console errors; date-fns-dependent components do not crash.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> at ContactPage.js line 60 (trip-type/travellers select). Non-breaking but should wrap raw text instead of rendering a span inside <option>.

action_items: Minor: Fix ContactPage.js line ~60 — remove <span> wrapper inside <option> to clear React hydration warning (likely a dev-overlay instrumentation artifact, but still appears as a console warning).
critical_code_review_comments: BrowserRouter basename={process.env.PUBLIC_URL || undefined} works correctly for preview (empty => root). GH Pages build will supply '/lcca' at build time.
Blog pages (BlogPage.js, BlogArticlePage.js) correctly import from frontend/src/data/articles.js — no network calls to /api/blog observed during full regression.
401 responses observed in console are from /api/auth/me (expected when unauthenticated); these do not affect public page rendering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression after GH Pages prep complete. Blog is fully static (local data). Only remaining nit is a hydration warning in ContactPage.js around the select/option rendering. Base URL: https://travel-voyara-demo.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend was NOT tested (per request).
